# DIMENSOR's three extra fonts, handed to the design system (brief §4, BRIEFS-fonts-licence-DRAFT.md; Patrick 2026-11-26)

The files are the ones DIMENSOR bundles today (`public/fonts/`, unchanged from the download; all three checked 2026-10-23). Group in DIMENSOR: "Pixel / Retro".

| Font | File | Licence | Credit line | Source | Shown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kiwi Soda | `kiwi-soda.ttf` (49,292 B) | CC BY 4.0 | Kiwi Soda by jeti | https://www.dafont.com/kiwisoda.font (also https://fontenddev.com/fonts/kiwi-soda/) | always, with its credit |
| Y224 | `y224.ttf` (28,068 B) | CC0 1.0 | Y224 by GGBotNet (courtesy credit; none required) | https://www.dafont.com/y224.font (also https://ggbot.itch.io/y224-font) | always |
| Darktech LDR | `darktech-ldr.ttf` (11,336 B) | CC BY-SA 3.0 | Darktech LDR by Michal "Neoqueto" Nowak, CC BY-SA 3.0 | https://www.dafont.com/darktech-ldr.font (FontStruction: http://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/715809) | only with the Share-alike switch on |

Licence texts: `licences/`.

Things to know:
- Darktech LDR carries OS/2 fsType 4 (Preview & Print embedding); the CC licence is what grants redistribution. The file is bundled unchanged, so ShareAlike is not triggered; editing or subsetting the font would trigger it (same licence for the adapted font).
- Coverage: Kiwi Soda and Y224 have upper and lower case, digits, ASCII punctuation, Latin-1. Darktech LDR has no accents and no Euro.
- DIMENSOR's `FONT_LIST` entries (`src/scene/fontlist.js`, generated by `scripts/build-fonts.mjs`) hold the same fields: id, licence, licenceFile, copyright, source, attribution.
- DIMENSOR switches to the shared set once the design tag lands (asset-alignment session sends the rest of §4 then). Nothing in DIMENSOR changes until then.
